prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 2 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Option 3 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 4 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 5 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 6 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import os
import secrets
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from urllib.parse import urlencode

import requests


class Auth0FederatedLoginFlow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        domain: Optional[str] = None,
        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
        client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
        redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
        audience: Optional[str] = None,
        session: Optional[requests.Session] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.domain = (domain or os.environ["AUTH0_DOMAIN"]).strip()
        self.client_id = client_id or os.environ["AUTH0_CLIENT_ID"]
        self.client_secret = client_secret or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
        self.redirect_uri = redirect_uri or os.environ["AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI"]
        self.audience = audience or os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
        self.base_url = f"https://{self.domain}"
        self.session = session or requests.Session()

    def build_authorization_url(
        self,
        connection: Optional[str] = None,
        scope: str = "openid profile email",
        state: Optional[str] = None,
        nonce: Optional[str] = None,
        prompt: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, str]:
        state = state or secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
        nonce = nonce or secrets.token_urlsafe(24)

        params = {
            "response_type": "code",
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
            "scope": scope,
            "state": state,
            "nonce": nonce,
        }
        if connection:
            params["connection"] = connection
        if prompt:
            params["prompt"] = prompt
        if self.audience:
            params["audience"] = self.audience

        url = f"{self.base_url}/authorize?{urlencode(params)}"
        return {"authorization_url": url, "state": state, "nonce": nonce}

    def exchange_code_for_tokens(self, code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        payload = {
            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "code": code,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
        }
        if self.client_secret:
            payload["client_secret"] = self.client_secret

        response = self.session.post(
            f"{self.base_url}/oauth/token",
            json=payload,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            timeout=30,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()

    def fetch_userinfo(self, access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        response = self.session.get(
            f"{self.base_url}/userinfo",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
            timeout=30,
        )
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()

    def normalize_claims(self, claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        identities = claims.get("identities") or []
        primary_identity = identities[0] if identities else {}

        given_name = claims.get("given_name")
        family_name = claims.get("family_name")
        name = claims.get("name")

        if not given_name and name:
            parts = str(name).split(" ", 1)
            given_name = parts[0] if parts else None
            family_name = family_name or (parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else None)

        normalized = {
            "subject": claims.get("sub"),
            "issuer": claims.get("iss"),
            "name": name,
            "given_name": given_name,
            "family_name": family_name,
            "middle_name": claims.get("middle_name"),
            "nickname": claims.get("nickname"),
            "preferred_username": claims.get("preferred_username"),
            "profile": claims.get("profile"),
            "picture": claims.get("picture"),
            "website": claims.get("website"),
            "email": claims.get("email"),
            "email_verified": claims.get("email_verified"),
            "gender": claims.get("gender"),
            "birthdate": claims.get("birthdate"),
            "zoneinfo": claims.get("zoneinfo"),
            "locale": claims.get("locale"),
            "phone_number": claims.get("phone_number"),
            "phone_number_verified": claims.get("phone_number_verified"),
            "updated_at": claims.get("updated_at"),
            "address": claims.get("address"),
            "raw_claims": claims,
            "federated_identity": {
                "provider": primary_identity.get("provider"),
                "user_id": primary_identity.get("user_id"),
                "connection": primary_identity.get("connection"),
                "is_social": primary_identity.get("isSocial"),
            },
        }
        return normalized

    def fetch_and_normalize_profile_from_code(self, code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        tokens = self.exchange_code_for_tokens(code)
        access_token = tokens.get("access_token")
        if not access_token:
            raise ValueError("Auth0 token response did not include access_token")

        claims = self.fetch_userinfo(access_token)
        profile = self.normalize_claims(claims)
        profile["tokens"] = {
            "access_token": tokens.get("access_token"),
            "id_token": tokens.get("id_token"),
            "token_type": tokens.get("token_type"),
            "expires_in": tokens.get("expires_in"),
            "scope": tokens.get("scope"),
        }
        return profile


def fetch_and_normalize_federated_user_profile(
    code: str,
    domain: Optional[str] = None,
    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
    client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
    redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
    audience: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    flow = Auth0FederatedLoginFlow(
        domain=domain,
        client_id=client_id,
        client_secret=client_secret,
        redirect_uri=redirect_uri,
        audience=audience,
    )
    return flow.fetch_and_normalize_profile_from_code(code)
